# Thunderbird Mail Interface Description

## System and Window Header

- **Operating System Indicator**: "Activities" is visible in the top-left corner, indicating a Linux desktop environment.
- **Application Title Bar**: "Thunderbird Mail" is displayed as the application name.
- **Current Date and Time**: "Oct 23 17:12" is shown in the center of the top bar.
- **System Tray Icons**: Located on the top-right, including volume control, network, and power icons.
- **Window Controls**: Minimize, maximize, and close buttons are present in the top-right corner of the Thunderbird window.
- **Email Account Display**: "anonym-x2024@outlook.com - Mozilla Thunderbird" is shown in the title bar of the main window.

## Main Application Window

- **Search Bar**: A search field labeled "Search... CTRL + K" is located at the top of the main window.
- **Account Settings**: A button labeled "Account Settings" with a gear icon is visible in the top-right corner.
- **Navigation Tabs**: Below the search bar, there are tabs for "Filters" and "End-to-end Encryption".
- **Feature Buttons**: Three buttons are present: "Filelink", "Feeds", and "Newsgroups".
- **Donation Message**: A message at the bottom right states: "Thunderbird is funded by users like you! If you like Thunderbird, please make a donation. The best way for you to ensure Thunderbird remains..." with a hyperlink to "make a donation".
- **Thunderbird Logo**: A faint outline of the Thunderbird bird logo is visible in the bottom-right corner.

## Left Sidebar (Navigation Panel)

- **Application Icons**: A vertical toolbar with icons for various applications:
  - Chrome browser
  - Firefox browser
  - Visual Studio Code
  - VLC media player
  - LibreOffice Writer
  - LibreOffice Calc
  - LibreOffice Impress
  - GIMP
  - File manager
  - Ubuntu Software
  - Help (question mark)
  - Trash bin
- **Thunderbird Icons**: Specific Thunderbird-related icons:
  - Mail icon (envelope)
  - Address book icon
  - Calendar icon
  - Tasks icon
  - Chat icon
  - Junk mail icon
  - Deleted items icon
  - Local Folders (expanded)
  - Trash folder
  - Outbox folder
  - Drafts folder
  - Sent folder
  - Archive folder
  - Blocked folder
  - Bi-directional folder
- **System Settings**: A gear icon for system settings is located at the bottom of the sidebar.
- **Application Grid**: A 3x3 grid icon for launching applications is at the bottom-left corner.
- **Status Indicator**: A "Done" status indicator is visible at the bottom-left corner.

## Email Composition Window

- **Window Title**: "Write: (no subject) - Thunderbird"
- **Window Controls**: Minimize, maximize, and close buttons are present in the top-right corner of the composition window.
- **Menu Bar**: Standard menu options: File, Edit, View, Insert, Format, Options, Tools, Help.
- **Toolbar**: Contains quick action buttons: Send, Encrypt, Spelling, Save, Contacts, and an Attach button with a dropdown.
- **Email Header Fields**:
  - **From**: "Anonym Tester <anonym-x2024@outlook.com>" with a dropdown for selecting a different sender.
  - **To**: An empty text field for entering recipient email addresses.
  - **Cc**: A field for carbon copy recipients.
  - **Bcc**: A field for blind carbon copy recipients.
- **Subject Field**: An empty text field for entering the email subject.
- **Text Formatting Toolbar**:
  - **Paragraph Style**: Dropdown menu with "Paragraph" selected.
  - **Text Width**: Dropdown menu with "Variable Width" selected.
  - **Text Alignment**: Buttons for left, center, right, and justify alignment.
  - **Font Style**: Buttons for bold (B), italic (I), underline (U), and strikethrough.
  - **Text Color**: A black color selector.
  - **List Styles**: Buttons for unordered list, ordered list, and nested list.
  - **Indentation**: Buttons for increasing and decreasing indentation.
  - **Special Characters**: A smiley face icon for inserting emojis.
- **Email Body**:
  - Contains the text: "Hello, you're goinHello, you're going to get rich!g to get rich!"
  - The word "goin" is highlighted in red with a wavy underline, indicating a spelling error.
  - The text is formatted in a monospaced font.

## Additional UI Elements

- **Status Bar**: A status bar at the bottom of the main window with a "Done" indicator.
